question: In a certain code language, ‘SITE’ is written as ‘WMXI’ and ‘MAKE’ is written as ‘QEOI’ . How will ‘TERM’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘SITE’ is written as ‘WMXI’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1d034efbdd4470fbc66692d10b6a980c81d62002ab082cef4c7683ca410b01.png] 

And,

‘MAKE’ is written as ‘QEOI’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16bf8eea2d0a964c6c21698b3b96029585d242bfd7494290dbaca8c4378d367f.png] 

Similarly,

‘TERM’ is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a4cd80e3db8c6277a909b2c77f21e63540cfc4621434619bf21e62ea54bde8d.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
